title: scDoRI: Single-cell Deep Multi-Omic Regulatory Inference
description:
scDoRI (single-cell Deep multi-Omic Regulatory Inference) is a deep learning model that infers enhancer-mediated gene regulatory networks (eGRNs) from single-cell multiome data, where RNA and ATAC are measured in the same cell.

By combining an encoder-decoder architecture with mechanistic constraints (enhancer-gene links and transcription factor binding logic), scDoRI learns topics that group co-accessible peaks together with their cis-linked genes and their upstream activator and repressor TFs, while scaling to large datasets through mini-batch training.

  • A single model for dimensionality reduction and eGRN inference.
  • Topics represent cell-state-specific regulatory programs.
  • Continuous eGRN modelling: each cell is a mixture of topics, so regulatory changes can be studied without predefined clusters.
  • Scales to large datasets via mini-batch training.

Source code and documentation: https://github.com/bioFAM/scDoRI
